change_summary: TCP server refuses startup unless COGNO_TASTE_TOKEN contains 32..=128 non-whitespace ASCII bytes
accepted sockets receive bounded read and write timeouts, configurable up to five minutes
verified packages are atomically written and fsynced in taste.inbox before OK; first-directory parent and inbox directory entries are synchronized on Unix
persistence failure returns ERR persistence_failed without updating idempotency memory
restart idempotency is rebuilt from digest-verified inbox packages
raw TCP bind resolution is performed once and rejected unless every endpoint is loopback; remote peers require an authenticated encrypted host tunnel terminating on loopback

acceptance: the TCP server cannot start without a bounded secret
raw transport is loopback-only and remote operation requires a separate authenticated encrypted host tunnel
read and write stalls are bounded per accepted connection
a verified PUSH is durably retained before OK and a storage error remains fail-closed
candidate and integrated trees match exactly for both PRs and every configured workflow passed on both exact integrated commits
limitations: the application protocol does not implement TLS; remote exposure is intentionally unsupported by the raw listener and requires a host tunnel
